message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large red block letters. Below the title is the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". The background depicts an orange and blue sky transitioning into a hazy horizon and a grey paved road.

The central subject is a dark grey truck moving to the right. A person in a white shirt and black songkok is driving, leaning out the window. In the truck's bed, several people in light blue and white shirts, along with one in a green vest, reach out. One person in a blue suit stands at the back with both arms raised.

A person in a yellow jacket and black pants is being pulled or helped onto the moving truck. Two people in the truck bed hold his hands as his legs hang in the air.

At the bottom, white text reads "KARPET MERAH UNTUK GIBRAN". Smaller white text below details political party movements and a vice-presidential candidate. Other headlines mention "Korupsi Baru Nikel Ilegal Mandiodo" and "Krisis Pangan di Depan Mata". A barcode, QR code, and publication details for August 2023 are in the top right.
